description:
Found during the bedrock-m7j audit.

`Bedrock.Internal.GenServer.Calls.call/3` (lib/bedrock/internal/gen_server/calls.ex:28-35) catches a fixed set of exit reasons — `{:noproc, _}`, `{{:nodedown, _}, _}`, `{:timeout, _}`, `{:normal, _}`, `{:shutdown, _}`, `{{:shutdown, _}, _}` — and maps them to `{:error, :unavailable}` or `{:error, :timeout}`. Any other exit reason escapes uncaught.

Verified during the audit: a server stopping with `:shutdown` yields `{:error, :unavailable}`; the same server stopping with `:eacces` raises `{:eacces, {GenServer, :call, [...]}}` into the caller.

## Failure scenario

A GenServer that dies of a genuine resource fault (`:enospc`, `:eacces`, `:emfile`) kills its callers rather than reporting unavailability — the exact case where a caller most wants a clean error to back off on. bedrock-m7j makes this reachable for the Shale log: the SegmentRecycler now exits with the real posix reason instead of masking it as `:shutdown`, and that reason propagates through the link into the log.

Blast radius is currently small and was checked: every production caller of `Log.push`/`Log.pull` runs inside a `Task.async_stream` that converts the exit (`commit_proxy/finalization.ex:1091-1098`), and the director's recovery phases are likewise wrapped. The one unwrapped site is `shale/recovery.ex:192`, running in the recovering log's own process, which its supervisor restarts.

## Fix

Normalize any unrecognised exit reason to `{:error, :unavailable}` rather than letting it escape — a dead callee is unavailable whatever killed it. Keep `:timeout` distinct. Consider preserving the reason as `{:error, {:unavailable, reason}}` if callers would benefit, but check every `case` on these returns first: several are non-exhaustive.

## Test (write first, must fail)

Start a server, stop it with `:eacces`, assert `Calls.call/3` returns `{:error, :unavailable}` rather than raising. Cover `:enospc` and an arbitrary term too.

comments.text: Draft PR: https://github.com/bedrock-kv/bedrock/pull/260 — fix + test landed, full suite green (2897 tests, 0 failures), cold audit PASS.

title: [BUG] Calls.call/3 does not normalize posix exit reasons, so a crashed worker raises instead of returning :unavailable
